about.heading: An Academic Reference Built for Curious Botanists and Growers
paragraphs: Plantipedia transforms botanical reference literature into a structured, high-contrast digital museum. Every entry pairs classical taxonomic rigor—from family lineage and floral morphology to pollination syndromes—with practical agronomic guidance rooted in South Asian, tropical, and global growing traditions.

Curated cleanly across 50 documented plant species with 15 Botanical Chapters per Plant and connected via a zero-key uplink to a 400,000+ Global Flora & Tree Collection, the archive delivers context-matched monographs backed by verified photography, bilingual EN / বাংলা nomenclature, and print-ready field sheets.

globalGateway.statusTag: ZERO-KEY LIVE UPLINK · STRICT LOCAL BYPASS
globalGateway.heading: Global Botanical Server Gateway
paragraphs: While Plantipedia's core archive curates 50 deeply authored 15-chapter botanical monographs, the living plant kingdom encompasses more than 400,000 vascular plant and tree taxa worldwide. This federated lookup console links directly to the Global Botanical Server so every search resolves accepted Linnaean binomials, hierarchical classifications, and verified field photography on demand.

Every query bypasses the local 50-species index without API keys or paywalls—aggregating multi-source taxonomic graphs, cross-script English and বাংলা vernacular matching, and biome-calibrated cultivation telemetry ready for full-page reading or split-screen comparison.

backbones.label: GBIF Backbone
backbones.detail: Resolves accepted Kingdom Plantae binomials, synonym keys, and authoritative global occurrence hierarchies.

backbones.label: Global Flora Index
backbones.detail: Synthesizes structured 15-chapter morphological, ecological, and ethnobotanical prose across worldwide taxa.

backbones.label: Wikidata Graph
backbones.detail: Bridges persistent P225 taxonomic nodes with bilingual EN / বাংলা nomenclature and IUCN Red List statuses.

backbones.label: iNaturalist Taxa
backbones.detail: Supplies research-grade field specimen plates covering floral structures, foliage, bark, and natural habitats.

backbones.label: Kew POWO
backbones.detail: Cross-verifies APG IV family placements, native biogeographic distributions, and botanical synonymy.

nextMilestone.heading: Next Up: Version 3.2 — Multi-Source Parallel Botanical Engine
nextMilestone.description: Immediately following Version 3.1, Plantipedia Version 3.2 upgrades the live lookup stack into a parallel multi-source botanical engine uniting GBIF, the Global Flora Index, Wikidata, iNaturalist, and Kew POWO. Alongside concurrent resolution across 400,000+ vascular taxa, v3.2 introduces automated cross-script EN / বাংলা alignment and typo-tolerant Levenshtein fuzzy search bound to the global '/' shortcut.

pillars.title: ⚡ 5-Source Parallel Aggregation
pillars.description: Executes simultaneous browser requests across GBIF Backbone, Global Flora Index, Wikidata P225, iNaturalist Taxa, and Kew POWO to assemble unified botanical dossiers without single-endpoint bottlenecks.

pillars.title: 🌐 Cross-Script EN / বাংলা Alignment
pillars.description: Expands semantic sitelink mapping between Linnaean binomials, English vernaculars, and Bengali Unicode nomenclature so every global taxon renders accurate bilingual headers and phonetic cues.

pillars.title: 🔍 Typo-Tolerant Fuzzy Search & Shortcuts
pillars.description: Combines client-side edit-distance matching for misspelled Latin or local plant names with an instant '/' keyboard focus shortcut active across every Plantipedia archive page.
